activity_summary: Anne went by the baker's. Hamnet had the morning on his grandfather's word and walked backward, reciting Latin nouns to make Judith laugh. Susanna named two shop-signs that were new since last year. You told him the sword may cross the lane and must come home.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept Hamnet off the trough, and limited the sword to the walk.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Went by the baker's to meet them at the frames.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Walked backward through the nouns for Judith.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Required the plural before she would count it.

facets.activity: Set out with the three children

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: Meet me by the new frames, and keep out of the lime.

quotes.speaker: susanna_shakespeare
quotes.text: The shearman's board by the corner is new painted since last year

quotes.speaker: hamnet_shakespeare
quotes.text: I can say the whole table walking backward to the corner.
